title: C: 2D Arrays
description: Work with 2D arrays: initialize a 3x3 matrix and print it in a grid format.

steps.title: Print a 3x3 Grid
steps.description: Declare a 3x3 int matrix: `int matrix[3][3] = {{1,2,3},{4,5,6},{7,8,9}}`. Print it in a grid format with each row on a new line and numbers separated by tabs.
hints: Outer loop for rows, inner loop for columns.
Use `\t` between numbers and `\n` after each row.

verification.failureMessage: Print the 3x3 matrix in grid format
